title: Login Form
content: Create secure login form with UX best practices. Fields: email (autocomplete="email"), password (autocomplete="current-password"). Password field: toggle visibility button (Eye/EyeOff icon). Remember me: checkbox with label. Links: "Forgot password?" below form. Submit button: full width, loading state. Divider: "Or continue with" separator line. Social login: Google, GitHub buttons with icons. Error display: generic "Invalid credentials" message.

variants.simple: Create login form with email, password fields and remember me checkbox.
variants.detailed: Create secure login form with UX best practices. Fields: email (autocomplete="email"), password (autocomplete="current-password"). Password field: toggle visibility button (Eye/EyeOff icon). Remember me: checkbox with label. Links: "Forgot password?" below form. Submit button: full width, loading state. Divider: "Or continue with" separator line. Social login: Google, GitHub buttons with icons. Error display: generic "Invalid credentials" message.
variants.advanced: Create secure login form with UX best practices and security considerations. Fields: email (autocomplete="email", type="email", autofocus on mount), password (autocomplete="current-password", type="password"). Password field: toggle visibility button (Eye when hidden, EyeOff when shown) positioned absolute right-3, aria-label="Show/Hide password". Remember me: checkbox with label using proper htmlFor, stores preference for extended session. Links: "Forgot password?" link below form navigating to reset page. Submit button: full width (w-full), primary style, loading state with disabled and spinner. Form submission: prevent default, validate client-side first. Divider: "Or continue with" separator using flex with hr lines and centered text. Social login: Google, GitHub, Apple buttons with brand icons from lucide or SVG, outlined style, initiates OAuth flow. Error display: generic "Invalid email or password" message in alert banner (never reveal which field is wrong for security). Rate limiting: track failed attempts in state, disable form for 30s after 5 failures with countdown. Redirect: to returnUrl query param, dashboard, or previous page on success. Persist session: short session by default, extended if remember me checked. Accessibility: autofocus email field, Enter submits form, aria-live region announces errors to screen readers. CSRF protection if not SPA. Consider 2FA flow trigger after successful password entry.
